tools.description: Keyword plus meaning search over source-linked enterprise AI deployments. Use it for a topic in a few words, for example 'claims automation', 'AI agents in banking' or 'predictive maintenance'. For a whole company use get_company_profile; to narrow by industry, country, provider or case type use hyb

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_usecases, hybrid_search_usecases, vector_search_usecases, get_usecase_details, find_similar_usecases · Private data: search_usecases, hybrid_search_usecases, vector_search_usecases, get_usecase_details, get_company_profile · Public sink: get_ai_trends.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_usecases, hybrid_search_usecases, vector_search_usecases, get_usecase_details, find_similar_usecases · Private data: search_usecases, hybrid_search_usecases, vector_search_usecases, get_usecase_details, get_company_profile · Public sink: get_ai_trends

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_usecases" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
